DamageMeter.name: 皮皮统计: Skada
DamageMeter.changelog: 兼容测试服 v0.109；修复毒伤/勒杀归因失效
changelog_detail: v0.109 重做了游戏随机数体系（Seed 从 uint 扩为 ulong），旧版直接读取会在开局抛异常导致进不了对局。Seed 读取改走反射兼容层，同一 DLL 继续支持 v0.103.2 / v0.107.1 / v0.109。
修复自 v0.107.1 起静默失效的毒液/勒杀伤害归因（游戏把 CombatHistoryEntry.CurrentSide 改为私有导致推断路径抛异常被吞掉）。现在所有支持版本上归因恢复正常。
DamageMeter.changelog_en: Compatibility with STS2 beta v0.109; fix poison/strangle attribution
changelog_detail_en: v0.109 overhauled the game's RNG (Seed widened uint→ulong): the old direct Seed read crashed run start with MissingMethodException. Seed access now goes through a reflective compat layer, so one DLL keeps running on v0.103.2 / v0.107.1 / v0.109.

Fixed poison/strangle power-damage attribution that had been silently broken since v0.107.1 (the game made CombatHistoryEntry.CurrentSide private, which killed the inference path via a swallowed MethodAccessException). Attribution works again on all supported versions.

SpeedX.name: 皮皮极速: SpeedX
SpeedX.changelog: 兼容 STS2 测试服 v0.110.1：恢复手柄模式检测
changelog_detail: v0.110.1 移除了 NControllerManager.IsUsingController，改用 InputType 枚举。旧 DLL 会反复抛出 MissingMethodException，导致伤害预览和空格快速出牌路径失效。
手柄检测现在会在运行时兼容旧 bool 属性和新枚举；同一 DLL 支持正式服 v0.107.1 与测试服 v0.110.1。
SpeedX.changelog_en: Compatibility with STS2 beta v0.110.1: restore controller-mode checks
changelog_detail_en: v0.110.1 removed NControllerManager.IsUsingController and replaced it with an InputType enum. The old direct getter threw MissingMethodException repeatedly, disabling damage preview and the space quick-play input path.
Controller detection now bridges the old bool and new enum shapes at runtime. One DLL supports official v0.107.1 and beta v0.110.1.

RemoveMultiplayerPlayerLimit.name: Remove Multiplayer Player Limit
RemoveMultiplayerPlayerLimit.changelog: 适配 v0.99 beta 新 mod 结构
changelog_detail: 新增 v0.99 格式 manifest（外部 JSON + id + affects_gameplay）
多人联机 API 无破坏性变更，Harmony patches 全部兼容

Rewind.name: 皮皮倒带: Rewind
Rewind.changelog: 修复知识恶魔战斗倒带误报失败、禁用倒带及回合显示错位
changelog_detail: 结束回合的动作队列排空后，继续等待怪物行动、历史选牌和目标回合初始化完成，不再提前把尚未发生的历史选牌判为遗漏。
只有抵达目标回合后才保存倒带状态；目标回合自己的待选牌仍交还玩家，真正遗漏的历史选择、战斗提前结束或回放越界仍会中止，并为回合等待增加超时保护。
按正式版 v0.107.1 与测试版 v0.111.0 的接口保持兼容；补充知识恶魔异步时序及异常边界回归用例。
Rewind.changelog_en: Fix premature rewind failure and turn mismatch during Knowledge Demon combat
changelog_detail_en: After the end-turn action queue drains, wait for enemy moves, historical choices and target-turn setup instead of rejecting choices that the independent combat turn loop has not reached yet.

Publish rewind state only at the target boundary. Leave the target turn's own chooser live, reject genuinely unconsumed choices, ended combat or target overshoot, and bound the final turn wait with a timeout.
Preserve API compatibility with official v0.107.1 and beta v0.111.0. Add deterministic Knowledge Demon timing and failure-boundary regressions.

ModConfig.name: 皮皮配置: ModConfig
ModConfig.changelog: 重新打包发布 zip，移除 legacy mod_manifest.json 修复游戏菜单里的重复模组条目
changelog_detail: 游戏 v0.99+ 起 <ModId>.json 是唯一的外部 root manifest，但 mod loader 依然会扫描 legacy mod_manifest.json —— 同目录两份 manifest 会被 loader 各自注册为独立模组条目，游戏菜单里就出现同名的红色「已加载」坏条目。
上一版发布 zip 里同时带了两份 manifest。虽然 ModManager.ps1 安装/更新时会调用 Remove-LegacyExternalManifest 清理玩家目录，但 zip 里还带着 mod_manifest.json，紧跟的 Copy-Item 又把它复制回来，等于白清理。
本版重新打包的 zip 只含 <Mod>.json + DLL + PCK，不含 mod_manifest.json。没有代码变更。从上一版更新过来时，ModManager 会删掉玩家目录里残留的 mod_manifest.json，重复条目消失。
ModConfig.changelog_en: repackage release zip without legacy mod_manifest.json to fix duplicate mod entry in game menu
changelog_detail_en: Game v0.99+ introduced <ModId>.json as the sole external root manifest. The mod loader still scans for legacy mod_manifest.json - so when a deployed folder contains both, the loader registers them as two separate mod entries and the game menu shows a duplicate red 'already loaded' row for that mod.

Releases up to and including the previous version shipped both manifests in the zip. Even though ModManager.ps1's install/update path calls Remove-LegacyExternalManifest to clean the target directory, the cleanup was undone because the zip still contained mod_manifest.json and the subsequent Copy-Item step re-deposited it.

This release ships a repackaged zip that contains only <Mod>.json + DLL + PCK. No code changes. Updating from the previous version will trigger ModManager to remove the old mod_manifest.json from the player's game folder and the duplicate entry disappears.

QuickLink.name: 皮皮快连: QuickLink
QuickLink.changelog: 兼容 STS2 测试服 v0.111.0 的联机握手与错误码
changelog_detail: QuickLink 现在会在运行时选择新版或旧版 NetHostGameService 与 NetClientGameService 构造函数，房主直连恢复和客机重连时都会正确携带新版游戏/模组握手信息。
房主可靠信号改为通过兼容层读取 ConnectedPeers 快照，不再绑定任一版本的属性签名。
发生变动的 NetError 改为按运行时名称解析与比较，并补充新的 LobbyJoinTimeout 重连情形。同一 DLL 同时支持正式服 v0.107.1 和测试服 v0.111.0。
QuickLink.changelog_en: Compatibility with the STS2 beta v0.111.0 multiplayer handshake
changelog_detail_en: QuickLink now selects the versioned or legacy NetHostGameService and NetClientGameService constructors at runtime, preserving the new game/mod handshake during direct host restore and client reconnect.
Reliable host signaling now reads ConnectedPeers through a compatibility snapshot instead of binding to either version's property signature.
Moved NetError values are resolved and compared by runtime name, including the new LobbyJoinTimeout reconnect case. The same DLL supports official v0.107.1 and beta v0.111.0.

SkadaHelper.name: 皮皮军师: SkadaHelper
SkadaHelper.changelog: 兼容 STS2 测试服 v0.110.1 的地图生命周期 API
changelog_detail: v0.110.1 用 _Notification(int) 替换了 NMapScreen._ExitTree，同时较新的测试分支把 NMapScreen.SetMap 的种子参数从 uint 改为 ulong。路线清理 Harmony 补丁现在会在运行时解析生命周期方法和 SetMap 签名。
这能避免 SkadaHelper 初始化因 MissingMethodException 中止，同时保留正式服 v0.107.1 的执行路径。
SkadaHelper.changelog_en: Compatibility with STS2 beta v0.110.1 map lifecycle APIs
changelog_detail_en: v0.110.1 replaced NMapScreen._ExitTree with _Notification(int), while newer beta branches use ulong rather than uint for NMapScreen.SetMap seed. The route-cleanup Harmony patch now resolves both lifecycle and SetMap signatures at runtime.
This prevents SkadaHelper initialization from aborting with MissingMethodException and preserves the v0.107.1 official path.
